SqliteInboxSubscriber(db_path, subscriber_name, effect) atomically commits one trusted SQLite-local callback effect and the subscriber_name/event_id/envelope_digest inbox binding.
Stable named subscriber retries skip already committed matching envelopes; same event ID with changed event envelope returns INBOX_EVENT_CONFLICT.
Callback receives a detached canonical event envelope excluding only delivery metadata outbox_id and created_at.

api_profile.callback_trust: Trusted in-process SQLite-local callback only; must not close or reconfigure connection, replace authorizer, manage transactions, invoke arbitrary external effects, or treat this as a Python security sandbox. Authorizer protects against accidental SQL transaction/table misuse.
